about: Source of truth for which function category each skill belongs to. tools/skill-map.mjs turns this into SKILLS-MAP.md and skills/<category>/README.md. Each skill lives in skills/<category>/<skill>/ and is called in Muse as /<skill>.

categories.title: Self-development
categories.purpose: Build, test and improve skills — the recursive loop that improves every skill, including these four.

categories.title: Session and workflow
categories.purpose: Start a session, work in isolation, prove changes, commit, pass gates, and know when to stop and ask.

categories.title: Project setup and orientation
categories.purpose: Give a project its profile and structure, and learn where everything lives.

categories.title: Records and handoff
categories.purpose: Write down what happened, what was decided and what comes next, for the user, Codex and the next session.

categories.title: Planning and product
categories.purpose: Decide what to build and why before any code, and check it from the user's side afterwards.

categories.title: Interface design
categories.purpose: Layout, states, wording, readability, look, accessibility and the UI-specific project rules.

categories.title: Build and test
categories.purpose: Write correct code with tests first, sound interfaces, and contracts that callers can rely on.

categories.title: Debugging and performance
categories.purpose: Find causes, not symptoms: reproduce, bisect, triage flakes, profile and fix slowness.

categories.title: Safety and control
categories.purpose: Keep software and agents inside their limits: security, privacy, hostile input, permissions, budgets and who decides.

categories.title: Data and recovery
categories.purpose: Store, migrate, back up, recover and trace data, and keep datasets and statistics honest.

categories.title: AI and models
categories.purpose: Run, prompt, evaluate and route language models, local or hosted, and Textclone's voice engine.

categories.title: Operations and release
categories.purpose: Run, check, ship and present projects: CI, releases, launchers, health checks, logs and the portfolio site.

categories.title: Flows (entry points)
categories.purpose: Start here for whole jobs. Each flow calls the right skills from the other categories in order.

finder: A new or empty project needs structure
Build a feature end to end
Change how a screen looks or is arranged
Try an idea to improve AI output or speed
Text, logs or pages from outside could steer the AI
Calling Gemini, OpenAI or DeepSeek (keys, limits, cost)
The portfolio site no longer matches a project
Pin what ran in this session
After a task: log what the skills missed
